notes.purpose: Role-specific first-hand observations during the escape route. Motive policy controls where and when a statement is available.
notes.canon: No generic city NPC witnessed the theft or knew the suspect before the crime. Statements report local observations, overheard words, documents voluntarily shown, or local reports explicitly identified as such.
notes.humor: Deadpan workplace comedy; no omniscient explanation of the crime.

gambling_debt.banker_large_withdrawal: They asked whether debts follow people across borders, then requested the account balance twice. I can print the same bad news in several fonts.

medical_treatment.banker_clinic_transfer: The payment reference named a clinic. They asked whether it would arrive before the treatment deposit was due. I explained the transfer time, not the diagnosis.

blackmail_secret.banker_anonymous_payments: They asked how much of a cash payment could be traced back to the sender. Then they asked whether I could forget the question. Our memory service is not a banking product.

repatriation_cause.banker_foundation_wire: They requested a transfer to a heritage foundation and said the receipt was 'for the people it belongs to'. I recorded the payment reference. The philosophy did not fit in the box.

career_coverup.banker_pension_cashout: They asked how quickly they could withdraw their pension if their professional association expelled them. I explained the notice period. They disliked both parts of that answer.

family_heirloom.banker_estate_inquiry: They showed me an old estate reference and asked whether an ancestor's account could prove family ownership. I handle balances, not hereditary arguments.

gambling_debt.maid_overheard_debt_call: I heard them on the phone: 'You will get your money after the sale. Stop calling.' Then they asked whether the breakfast was included. Apparently one debt at a time.

medical_treatment.maid_medical_envelope: An open clinic envelope was on the desk. A treatment price and a payment deadline were circled. They asked me not to move it. I worked around it, like the rest of the furniture with feelings.

blackmail_secret.maid_burned_letters: The room smelled of burnt paper. While I changed the towels, I heard: 'I paid you. You said the photographs would disappear.' I can remove stains. That sounded outside my department.

repatriation_cause.maid_origin_map: There was a museum leaflet beside a parcel marked 'RETURN TO THE COMMUNITY'. They told me it was going where it belonged. I asked whether the empty cups were too.

career_coverup.maid_shredded_documents: A page headed 'Internal audit' was lying beside a very full shredder. They asked whether we collected confidential waste separately. We collect all panic in the same bin.

family_heirloom.maid_family_portrait: They showed me an old family photograph with a jewel in it and said, 'That should never have left our family.' I recognised the photograph as old. I am not qualified to date a grievance.

gambling_debt.parkingowy_impatient_customer: They paced beside the car waiting for a call. When it came, I heard, 'The creditor wants the money tonight.' Then they paid the parking fee in coins. I counted. Several feelings occurred.

medical_treatment.parkingowy_clinic_rush: They asked which exit led towards the private clinics and kept checking a treatment appointment on their phone. Their concern was understandable. Their parking across two bays was not.

blackmail_secret.parkingowy_midnight_pickup: Their speakerphone was loud enough for my booth: 'Leave the museum piece where I told you, or the photographs go out.' I heard that sentence. I did not see who was calling.

repatriation_cause.parkingowy_border_roads: They asked about taking a parcel back to its community without selling it. Then they asked which roads avoided inspections. I suggested the official crossing. It was not the popular answer.

career_coverup.parkingowy_angry_calls: They sat in the car shouting, 'If the auditors see that piece, they will check the signatures.' I heard the call from the booth. Gerald, whoever that is, also had a difficult afternoon.

family_heirloom.parkingowy_old_estate_trip: They showed me a family estate photograph while asking for directions. Said they wanted to check an old inventory. I checked their parking ticket. We were both doing research.

gambling_debt.knajpa_threat_call: They answered a call at the table and whispered, 'Do not send your collector here. I will get the money.' Then they left half their soup. The soup was not involved in the dispute.

medical_treatment.knajpa_medical_broker_talk: I heard them tell their companion, 'Selling the artifact will cover the treatment deposit.' That is what was said at the table. I cannot confirm the treatment. I can confirm the unpaid dessert.

blackmail_secret.knajpa_dead_drop: They put an envelope under a chessboard. Another customer collected it without playing a move. I then heard, 'This buys silence until tomorrow.' Terrible chess. Very efficient payment.

repatriation_cause.knajpa_advocate_meeting: They met someone carrying a heritage campaign leaflet. I heard them argue about returning a piece to its community and the cost of shipping it. The shipping part sounded painfully sincere.

career_coverup.knajpa_audit_rant: They complained that an audit would expose forged signatures and mismatched provenance papers. I heard the complaint. I did not audit it. My own accounts are enough theatre.

family_heirloom.knajpa_portrait_questions: They showed an old portrait to the people at the next table and asked whether anyone recognised the family or its jewellery. This is a restaurant. Our genealogy service remains disappointing.

gambling_debt.police_harassment_report: The visitor asked how to report threats from a debt collector without naming the creditor. I took down what they would tell me. It was a remarkably short statement.

medical_treatment.police_clinic_disturbance: A clinic reported a visitor refusing to leave over a treatment deposit. The caller described the person you asked about. That is a report, not a finding about why they needed the money.

blackmail_secret.police_followed_report: They came to the desk saying someone was following them and threatening to release photographs. They would not identify the caller. We recorded the allegation, not the caller's identity.

repatriation_cause.police_export_questions: They asked which forms apply when returning a disputed museum object to its community. I explained that a belief about ownership is not export authorisation. They requested a shorter form.

career_coverup.police_archive_trespass: The local archive reported a visitor refusing to leave the provenance section. The visitor said an audit was about to ruin their career. We logged both accounts. Neither reduced the paperwork.

family_heirloom.police_inheritance_claim: They asked how to establish a family claim to a museum jewel and brought a copy of an old inventory. We explained the civil process. 'But it is ours' is not a case number.

gambling_debt.bum_collector_argument: I saw someone corner them by the depot. Heard 'your gambling debt' and 'Friday'. Your person nodded like Friday was an illness. I changed benches. I prefer my deadlines voluntary.

medical_treatment.bum_clinic_bench: They waited outside the private clinic holding a briefcase. I heard them say on the phone, 'The sale will pay for the operation.' I did not see inside the case. It paid no rent on the bench.

blackmail_secret.bum_black_car_argument: They stood beside a dark car while the person inside said, 'Pay, or everyone sees the pictures.' I heard the threat. Tinted windows are much less effective against ears.

repatriation_cause.bum_consulate_watch: They waited near the consulate with a parcel and told someone on the phone, 'I am bringing it back, not selling it.' I cannot tell you what was in the parcel. It was not my lunch.

career_coverup.bum_shredder_dumpster: I saw them put a bundle of torn papers in the bin behind the notary. One loose piece said 'provenance audit'. I can read two words without becoming the investigating authority.

family_heirloom.bum_cemetery_research: They compared names on gravestones with an old family album and kept talking about a missing heirloom. I saw the album. I did not attend the inheritance hearing.

gambling_debt.fence_artifact_offer: They offered me the museum piece cheaply and said the proceeds had to reach a gambling creditor that night. That was their proposal. I declined. Desperation is not a discount code.

medical_treatment.fence_artifact_for_treatment: They asked whether the piece would cover a relative's treatment deposit. I heard the reason they gave. I did not verify the hospital bill. I also did not agree to buy it.

blackmail_secret.fence_blackmail_delivery: They wanted the artifact delivered, not sold. Said a blackmailer had demanded the piece in exchange for keeping photographs private. I am a fence, not a confidential postal service.

repatriation_cause.fence_refused_sale: They asked for a route back to the object's community and refused my offer to buy it. 'Home, not the market,' they said. A terrible opening position for a negotiation.

career_coverup.fence_evidence_for_safekeeping: They wanted the piece hidden before an audit could connect it to forged provenance papers. Those were their words. I declined to become the storage department of that sentence.

family_heirloom.fence_not_for_sale: I asked whether the piece was for sale. They said, 'It belonged to my family. I am taking it back.' That is their ownership claim, not my professional valuation.

gambling_debt.stewardess_debt_confession: I heard the passenger tell their neighbour, 'One sale and I can pay the gambling debt.' I was serving drinks, not taking a sworn statement. I still remember that part.

medical_treatment.stewardess_rebooking_surgery: They asked about an earlier connection and showed me a message about a relative's operation. They said the deposit could not wait. I could check the connection, not the medical account.

blackmail_secret.stewardess_demand_note: The passenger dropped an open note while reaching for their bag: 'THE ARTIFACT. NOT MONEY. OR THE PHOTOGRAPHS GO PUBLIC.' I handed it back. It did not look like a loyalty offer.

repatriation_cause.stewardess_restitution_crate: Their luggage was marked 'RETURN TO THE COMMUNITY'. They told their neighbour they were taking something home, not selling it. I saw the label, not the contents. Baggage has boundaries.

career_coverup.stewardess_burn_envelope: They asked whether they could destroy an envelope before an audit and muttered that the artifact was evidence against them. I refused the suggestion involving the lavatory. The smoke detector outranks both of us.

family_heirloom.stewardess_heirloom_declaration: They showed their neighbour an old inventory page and said, 'This proves the jewel was our family's. I am bringing it back.' I heard the claim. I was not conducting probate at cruising altitude.
